# Test fixtures: presets of the workshop's development studies

The tests use these presets to exercise single settings of the materials workshop. They are configurations
of development studies that preceded the competition study, kept as the tests need them; they are not
studies to run, and their comments refer to records that are not released. `tests/conftest.py` puts this
folder on the preset search path (`OAOS2_ORGANIZATIONS`). The workshop's own presets are in
`library/organizations/`; see docs/WORLD.md.
